synths.name: Serum
synths.bendRange: MPE bend range at the bottom of the same menu; set 48
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Serum: MENU (top bar) > MPE Enabled, and set the MPE bend range at the bottom of that menu to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

synths.name: Serum 2
synths.bendRange: MPE Bend Range on its Global page; set 48
synths.noteExpressions: Takes VST3 note expressions with MPE off
synths.advice: Check MPE is on in Serum 2: MENU > MPE Enabled, with MPE Bend Range 48 on its Global page, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

sources.says: Serum 2 guide: MPE switch; with it off, VST3 note expressions

synths.name: Analog Lab
synths.instead: For each note's own expression, load the instrument itself: Pigments, or a V Collection instrument with an Enable MPE setting
synths.advice: Arturia says Analog Lab itself has no MPE.

sources.says: Analog Lab is not MPE compatible; Pigments and many V Collection instruments are

synths.name: Pigments
synths.bendRange: Bend Range next to it; set 48
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Pigments: Settings (top toolbar) > Enable MPE, with Bend Range 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

synths.name: Arturia V Collection instruments
synths.enable: Gear icon > Settings tab > Enable MPE
synths.bendRange: Bend Range next to it; set 48
synths.notes: Many have MPE; one without that setting has none
synths.advice: Many Arturia V Collection instruments have MPE: gear icon > Settings tab > Enable MPE, with Bend Range 48. One without that setting has no MPE: set Synth expects to Plain MIDI.

sources.says: Which Arturia instruments are MPE compatible

synths.name: ZENOLOGY and Roland Cloud instruments
synths.advice: Roland's ZENOLOGY and Roland Cloud instruments have no MPE.

sources.says: ZENOLOGY product page: no MPE among its features

synths.name: Omnisphere 2
synths.advice: Omnisphere 2 has no MPE (Omnisphere 3 has).

synths.name: Omnisphere 3
synths.enable: System page (gear icon) > MPE on; load the patch into Part 1 only
synths.bendRange: MPE Pitch Bend Range on the System page; set 48
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Omnisphere 3: System page (gear icon) > MPE on, with MPE Pitch Bend Range 48, and load the patch into Part 1 only (Omnisphere 2 has no MPE: use Plain MIDI).

synths.name: Vital
synths.enable: ADVANCED tab > MPE ENABLED (saved with each preset)
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Vital: ADVANCED tab > MPE ENABLED. It's saved with each preset, so loading one can turn it off again. Vital's per-note bend range is fixed at 48, as MPE Roll's is.

synths.name: Diva
synths.enable: Pitch Bend Up and Down set to MPE (polyphonic presets)
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP version: CLAP note expressions, nothing to set up
synths.advice: Diva has MPE from 1.4.8, for polyphonic presets: set its Pitch Bend Up and Down to MPE.
synths.clapAdvice: Its CLAP version needs nothing set up when Note expressions are on in MPE settings.

synths.name: Zebra2
synths.advice: Zebra2 has no MPE (Zebra 3 has).

sources.says: u-he forum: Zebra2 has no MPE

synths.name: Zebra 3
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP version: CLAP note expressions, nothing to set up
synths.advice: Zebra 3 has MPE.
synths.clapAdvice: Its CLAP version needs nothing set up when Note expressions are on in MPE settings.

synths.name: Phase Plant
synths.enable: Its settings > MPE on, MIDI channel Any
synths.bendRange: Bend Range next to it; set 48
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in Phase Plant's settings, with Bend Range 48 and its MIDI channel set to Any.

sources.says: users: Massive X has no MPE

synths.name: Kontakt
synths.advice: Kontakt has no MPE mode of its own (a few libraries have one: if yours does, turn it on there).

sources.says: KSP: MPE is up to a library's script

synths.name: Waves synths
synths.advice: Waves synths have no MPE.

synths.name: Surge XT
synths.enable: Turns itself on from MPE Roll's setup (MPE settings > Send MPE setup now)
synths.noteExpressions: CLAP version: CLAP note expressions, nothing to set up
synths.advice: Surge XT turns MPE on by itself from MPE Roll's setup (MPE settings > Send MPE setup now, if it hasn't).
synths.clapAdvice: Its CLAP version needs nothing set up when Note expressions are on.

sources.says: Surge reads the MPE configuration message

synths.name: Equator2
synths.bendRange: Per-note bend range in the same settings; set 48
synths.advice: Choose MPE mode (not Standard) in Equator2's MIDI settings, with a per-note bend range of 48.

synths.name: SWAM instruments
synths.advice: Set its MIDI Profile to MPE (MIDI settings). SWAM instruments play one note at a time.

synths.name: Noisy and Imagine
synths.enable: Its MPE presets, or MPE on in its settings
synths.advice: Use its MPE presets, or turn MPE on in its settings, with a per-note bend range of 48.

synths.name: Memorymode
synths.enable: Settings (gear icon) > Interface > Enable MPE mode
synths.advice: Turn on MPE in it: Settings (gear icon) > Interface > Enable MPE mode, then set the bend range on its MPE tab to 48, MPE Roll's per-note bend range.

synths.name: Elka-X
synths.advice: It has no MPE, Cherry Audio says.
